title: Predation on frogs and tadpoles: interaction records from open-access natural-history notes (2022-2026)
description:
Species-interaction records (predator, prey, interaction type, locality, date) for predation or feeding events on frogs and tadpoles, taken from recent open-access natural-history notes and formatted for Global Biotic Interactions (GloBI, http://globalbioticinteractions.org). Each row cites its source paper by DOI. Only facts and citations are recorded; no text from the papers is copied. Every row was extracted by one reader and re-checked against the paper by an independent second pass. 'New' in the project notes means new to GloBI, not new to science.

Version 0.1.1: 46 interactions from 36 notes (Reptiles & Amphibians, Revista Latinoamericana de Herpetologia, Phyllomedusa, Herpetozoa, The Herpetological Bulletin). Licence: CC BY 4.0.
